draft_en.subject: The PoE switches you source from ONV and similar - two neutral-brand numbers
draft_en.body:
Hello ATZ team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 17 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches you currently source from ONV and similar suppliers, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5.

One question: which PoE SKU do you reorder most? Send the current model number and I quote its exact equivalent.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
